Messages.Author: Disco_Stu
Messages.Body:
Hey again,

So, an attempt to put together some Research Area-related cards. I figured I'd try to use the area as a resource for new sorts of effects, rather than simply as a card storage mechanism.

Desperate Times
:master:
Master. Trifle.
Only usable if you have less than 6 pool. Gain 1 pool. Each Methuselah may burn a card in their research area to gain 1 pool.

Desperate Measures

Cost: 1
Requires a ready vampire.
Move X cards at random from your hand to your research area to move X blood to this vampire from the blood bank.
Cards moved in this way are not replaced until your discard phase.
(okay, so it's a bloody long first sentence...)

Hit the Books

+1 stealth action. Requires a ready anarch.
and/or  and/or
Burn a card in your research area to gain +2 hand size for the remainder of the turn.
If using , this vampire untaps at the end of the action.
If using , you may target a card in another Methuselah’s research area instead (this becomes a  action).
If using , this vampire gains 1 blood if the action is successful.

cheers
Disco Stu

Messages.Author: Disco_Stu
Messages.Body:
Hi Baaliprimogen,

I like your idea of playing cards from the research area; it's a great method to effectively expand your hand for certain key strategies. I could imagine that there would be some nice combos for certain clans or sects - perhaps a minion who can move certain cards to your research area as an action (political actions for Ventrue, for example, or combat cards for Brujah) with other cards allowing you to then use the research area during a certain phase or action.

I think one advantage of doing it this way is that it could be used to play up a more scholarly angle to certain clans - I can imagine a Tremere, Kiasyd or Brujah elder could have some sort of research area-related special text, but we probably shouldn't think about adding one for the Blood Brothers

cheers
Disco Stu

Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
After looking in the V20 book i got inspired. How about this card.

Scientist
Type: Master
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire sucessfully performs an action and no reaction cards are played, he or she can put an action card from your library to your research area (shuffle afterwards) after action is resolved. A vampire can have only one archetype.

Maybe overpowered. But something like this would be fun.
